preprocessing: exact CV-002 PIL center-crop CLIP target and Sat2Cap aerial_pixels with224 input; extract only single300px crops, never whole1500 windows

training.loss: mean over9 fit queries of -log_softmax(cosine(projected_ground, each81 same-scene aerial)/0.1)[shared_proxy_positive]
training.batch: all9 unique source queries per update; each normalized query counted once, not25 times
training.evaluation_timing: after final500 only, no best-checkpoint selection
training.negative_caveat: neighboring views may share scene content; exact-cell negatives are weak supervision and may contain semantic false negatives; do not tune away after scores

evaluation.score: normalized512D cosine, all decisions reconstructed from saved features/checkpoint, unchanged CV-002 hash ties
evaluation.Full: apply same arm h to genuine normalized ground feature
evaluation.weak_Mean: fixed mean of9 fit normalized ground features then normalize and apply h; no dev mean for weak scene control
evaluation.MMGAG_Mean: original mean of16 normalized ground features then normalize and apply h, preserving CV-002 control definition at identity
evaluation.weak_Wrong: next development group cyclically in frozen development list, no same-source wrong target
evaluation.sampling_unit: five weak-development groups and ten existing MM-GAG development groups reported separately;25 variants do not add geography; geographic independence not proven

resources.engineering: initial subset from same1148 bound images, saved successful features reused; engineering calls count toward total, no hidden re-extraction
resources.retention: no raw/encoder copies; initial and final head, one active recovery, features/configs/logs; no unbounded optimizer checkpoints

engineering_gates: initial U0 head reproduces identity to1e-6 on frozen features
encoders no gradients and tensor identities unchanged
finite nonzero head gradient and bounded head-only updates
checkpoint resume exactly reproduces uninterrupted synthetic run
candidate bank/source/label never part of head input
stopping: one seed and one fixed500-update budget; any effect gate fails closes factor; no rank/loss/temperature/source sweeps or fourth zero-training probe, no navigation/default upgrade
